name: field
useFor: Wrap every form control in a Field with a FieldLabel, an optional FieldDescription and a FieldError; group fields in FieldGroup and related choices in FieldSet with a FieldLegend. Use orientation="horizontal" for a check, radio or switch beside its label, FieldContent with FieldTitle and FieldDescription for a setting row, and a FieldLabel wrapping a Field for a choice card. Pass invalid (or data-invalid) to mark the control and show the error.
constraints: Errors in any color but the orange
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: its 14px type, the quiet and 32 percent lines (--line-quiet, --line-margin), its Chakra Petch group heads (.pr-table) and the principles for fields

examples.content:
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSeparator, FieldSet, FieldTitle } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";

export function Preview() {
  return (
    <FieldGroup className="max-w-sm">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Repository</FieldLabel>
        <Input placeholder="acme/payments-api" />
        <FieldDescription>Agents clone it into a fresh sandbox for every thread.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field invalid>
        <FieldLabel>Branch prefix</FieldLabel>
        <Input defaultValue="agent fix/" />
        <FieldError>Branch names cannot contain spaces.</FieldError>
      </Field>
    </FieldGroup>
  );
}

export function Sets() {
  return (
    <FieldSet className="max-w-md">
      <FieldLegend>Notifications</FieldLegend>
      <FieldDescription>Choose when you hear about agent work.</FieldDescription>
      <FieldGroup className="gap-4">
        <Field orientation="horizontal">
          <Checkbox defaultChecked />
          <FieldLabel>A pull request is ready for review</FieldLabel>
        </Field>
        <Field orientation="horizontal">
          <Checkbox defaultChecked />
          <FieldLabel>A check fails on an agent branch</FieldLabel>
        </Field>
        <Field orientation="horizontal">
          <Checkbox />
          <FieldLabel>A thread is waiting for input</FieldLabel>
        </Field>
      </FieldGroup>
    </FieldSet>
  );
}

export function Settings() {
  return (
    <FieldGroup className="max-w-md">
      <Field orientation="horizontal">
        <FieldContent>
          <FieldTitle>Auto-merge green pull requests</FieldTitle>
          <FieldDescription>Merge once every required check passes and a reviewer approves.</FieldDescription>
        </FieldContent>
        <Switch defaultChecked />
      </Field>
      <FieldSeparator />
      <Field orientation="horizontal" disabled>
        <FieldContent>
          <FieldTitle>Run agents on Windows sandboxes</FieldTitle>
          <FieldDescription>Available on the Team plan.</FieldDescription>
        </FieldContent>
        <Switch />
      </Field>
    </FieldGroup>
  );
}

export function ChoiceCards() {
  return (
    <FieldSet className="max-w-md">
      <FieldLegend variant="label">Sandbox size</FieldLegend>
      <RadioGroup defaultValue="standard" className="gap-3">
        <FieldLabel>
          <Field orientation="horizontal">
            <FieldContent>
              <FieldTitle>Standard</FieldTitle>
              <FieldDescription>2 vCPU, 8 GiB RAM</FieldDescription>
            </FieldContent>
            <RadioGroupItem value="standard" />
          </Field>
        </FieldLabel>
        <FieldLabel>
          <Field orientation="horizontal">
            <FieldContent>
              <FieldTitle>Large</FieldTitle>
              <FieldDescription>8 vCPU, 32 GiB RAM</FieldDescription>
            </FieldContent>
            <RadioGroupItem value="large" />
          </Field>
        </FieldLabel>
      </RadioGroup>
      <FieldSeparator>or</FieldSeparator>
      <Button variant="outline" className="self-start">Bring your own runner</Button>
    </FieldSet>
  );
}

title: Field
description: Form layout on Base UI's Field and Fieldset: a 14px medium label 8px above the control, 14px quiet help and 14px orange errors below, fields 24px apart, Chakra Petch 20px set legends, choice cards framed in the quiet rule that turn ink when chosen, and an "or" between two quiet rules.
